state.goal: Prioritize player-visible mobile quality work from verified evidence.
constraints: No API call in a frame loop

priority.instructions: Which unresolved area has strongest concrete evidence and player impact? If insufficient or resolved choose none.

criteria.readability: Observed unclear objective, attack or feedback
criteria.animation: Observed abrupt timing or broken movement
criteria.art: Observed geometry, material or composition flaw

evidence_sufficient.instructions: Do the observations establish an actionable unresolved issue, rather than a guess?

impact.instructions: Rate only the strongest demonstrated player impact.

verification.instructions: Select a check that resolves the most important uncertainty.

criteria.timing_tests: Check state timing and frame independence
criteria.render_comparison: Compare actual scene geometry and framing
criteria.device_profile: Measure frame-time and memory on target device
criteria.none: No justified check from present evidence

next_owner.instructions: Who should perform the next task from available evidence?

criteria.luna: Read source or research and collect missing evidence
criteria.measurement_tools: Run the necessary tests, renders or profiler
